provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: qualified owned StorageClass/PVC/StatefulSet and finite marker writer/reader

cases.task: Connect StatefulSet volumeClaimTemplates,data mount and StorageClass.
cases.expected: The data claim is mounted at /data and depends on a qualified lesson-local class.

cases.task: Use a bounded exclusive-create writer for a synthetic marker and retain its hash.
cases.expected: One initialization receipt,claim/PV identities and a known marker checksum.

cases.task: Use the host operation with the recorded Pod UID and observe its successor.
cases.expected: New Pod UID with the intended stable ordinal and same claim binding.

cases.task: Read the marker after replacement without running the writer.
cases.expected: Hash remains h1 in the synthetic trace;actual live bytes/hash are recorded separately.

cases.task: Compare StatefulSet claim retention with PV reclaim policy and cluster release.
cases.expected: Each lifecycle boundary has its own policy;retention is not backup.

cases.task: Use supplied binding/events to propose a minimal class/capacity/topology check.
cases.expected: No destructive claim reset;the missing capability or binding condition is identified.
